layout_and_navigation.app_shell: Flex layout with fixed left sidebar (width 260px desktop, collapsible), main scrollable content area, and top navbar (z-40, backdrop blur)
layout_and_navigation.top_nav: Workspace dropdown selector, Command Launcher trigger (⌘K), Notifications bell, User Profile menu with avatar

key_features_design_specs.landing_page: Hero section with futuristic network visual, stats counter, interactive demo widget preview, feature grid, pricing tier cards, Google Sign-In button
key_features_design_specs.knowledge_base: Drag-and-drop PDF upload dropzone with progress bar, status pills (Processing, Indexed, Failed), searchable document table, document chunk inspector side-panel
key_features_design_specs.research_chat: Chat session sidebar, main message thread with streaming markdown, clickable source inline citations, citation details slide-over panel with similarity score & snippet context
key_features_design_specs.semantic_search: Mode toggle (Semantic, Keyword, Hybrid), query input with filter bar (threshold slider, top-k dropdown), ranked passage visual results with similarity score badges
key_features_design_specs.intelligence_studio: Tabbed workspace: Document Summarization, Sentiment Analysis, Document Comparison (side-by-side or split diff), Technical Concept Explainer
key_features_design_specs.research_intelligence: Structured academic analysis view: Objectives, Methodology, Findings, Limitations, Future Scope, Research Gap Finder matrix, Follow-up Questions generator
key_features_design_specs.analytics_dashboard: Recharts visual charts (Latency distribution, Token usage, Query throughput, RAG Evaluation Lab Recall@K & Precision@K benchmarking scores), system logs stream
key_features_design_specs.settings: RAG retriever parameters (Top-K slider, similarity score threshold, chunk size/overlap, LLM model selector, vector DB status)

testing_and_attributes.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs, citation links, modal close buttons) MUST have kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark futuristic aesthetic with deep midnight background #080B12 and elevated dark surfaces #0E1420.
Use JetBrains Mono or Fira Code for all data readouts, citation tags, token metrics, and JSON chunk displays.
Do NOT rely on transparent dropdown/header backgrounds—always supply solid dark background or heavy backdrop-blur (#080B12/80) to avoid overlaps.
Ensure every clickable button, input, tab, and citation tag carries a data-testid attribute.
Ensure toast notifications use sonner (/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar).
Build clean empty states and skeleton loading cards for every view during async API fetching.
